harper: Heads-up — VaultGate dedicated private rollout planned for 2026-04-05 02:00 UTC. Need final sign-off on safety-pin and KMS window. @ops-jen @samir
ops-jen: I'm on it. Checking KMS rotations... no rotations scheduled between 01:30–03:30 UTC. :white_check_mark:
samir: What are we pinning? runtime or model? we should pin both for rollback clarity.
harper: pin both. runtime=`rw-runtime:2.12.0`, svc-image=`rwinf/dedicated:2026-04-05-v1` (canary 10% slice).
maria: noted. will update release notes and canary checklist. Is KV cache schema change included?
harper: no KV schema change. only runtime patch (scheduler fixes) and kvcache hotfix; no DB migrations.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary 'vaultgate-canary' for 02:05 UTC on slice vaultgate-01, target 10% traffic. runbook: /runbooks/vaultgate-dedicated-canary
ops-jen: setting safety-pin: canary latency p95 < 120ms, error rate < 0.5%. Rollback trigger: any 5m window with errors > 1%.
samir: also add fallback policy to switchover to `rwinf/dedicated:stable-2.11` in case of KV cache overload
harper: added fallback. will attach to release notes. @maria please add to "rollback plan" section.
maria: done — release notes link: https://internal.redwood/release-notes/vaultgate-2026-04-05 (draft).
liam: ops heads: who will own the first 30m post-switchover? I'm available until 04:30 UTC.
ops-jen: I'll take 02:00–03:00 UTC, liam takes 03:00–04:30. :thumbsup:
harper: final checklist: KMS ok, pins set, deploybot scheduled, safety-pin thresholds set, docs linked. Requesting PM signoff @maria for customer communication.
maria: sign-off from PM for customer-facing blurb: "No downtime expected; minor quality fixes; we may revert if latency regresses." Sending to account team now.
deploy-bot: canary started at 02:05:12 UTC on vaultgate-01 (10% traffic). monitoring hooks active.
harper: thanks. keeping thread pinned. :rocket:
